Woollett Aquatics Center

4601 Walnut Ave, Irvine, CA 92604 · 949-724-6717

  • Competition Pool: 50 m by 25 yd; 8 lanes long course or 17 short course
  • Diving Pool: 50 m by 25 yd; two 1-meter and two 3-meter boards; 17 lanes short course
  • Teaching Pool: 25 yd; lessons, shallow-water lap swim and water aerobics

Public hours: Monday to Friday 6am to 8pm, Saturday and Sunday 8am to noon.
